scenes.name: tidal
scenes.prompt: An alien tidal basin on a fractured moon. An enormous folded ivory shell rises diagonally from a perfectly still emerald-green sea, its open inner chambers stepping inward into smaller repeating chambers. Rust-red mineral terraces sweep across the lower foreground, separated by narrow pools of clear emerald-green water. Slender copper spires grow from the terraces and bend toward the shell. Bands of tiny eroded ridges, granular mineral deposits and intricate branching seams cover the stone. A distant ringed planet hangs low in a black star-filled sky. Vermilion, ivory, emerald and oxidized copper, with raking amber sunlight from the upper left. Low wide view with a close foreground ledge, an open stretch of water and the immense shell beyond. No bridge, doorway, vegetation, people or text. A meticulous surreal digital environment. The shell has thin porcelain-like edges, finely pitted exterior layers and nacre within its deep chambers. Terraces expose thousands of razor-thin sedimentary laminae, tiny angular quartz grains and branching copper veins. Sharp reflected edges lie on the still water. Restrained highlights and clean contact shadows reveal physical relief; clear air, deep focus and finely resolved distant silhouettes. Change all sea and channel water to emerald green while preserving the land, shell, spires and planet.
